source.label: thm:11
source.quote: When using \autoref{alg:framework} with the selection in \autoref{rem:sec1}, we have R_T(\Lambda_T)\leq 2(1+W)\max_{1\leq t\leq T}\triangle_t+2\sqrt{W\sum_{t=1}^T\triangle_t^2}, where $\triangle_t=\max_m l_{t,m}- \min_{m} l_{t,m}$.

results.notes: Comparator is a general comparator sequence from a designed class (fixed, switching, contextual, periodic); best_switching_sequence is the closest vocabulary term. Regret is sum E_q[l] - l_{comparator}.

symbols.W: complexity bound of the competing comparator sequence

conditions: W(Lambda_T) <= W for the comparator sequence

source.quote: When using \autoref{alg:framework} with the selection in \autoref{rem:sec2}, we have R_T(\Lambda_T)\leq 6\sqrt{W\sum_{t=1}^T\triangle_t^2}

results.notes: General comparator class mapped to best_switching_sequence.

symbols.W: complexity bound of the competing comparator sequence
symbols.Rng: uniform bound on the per-round loss range triangle_t

conditions: loss ranges uniformly bounded by Rng (paper writes triangle_t >= triangle, apparently a typo)

source.quote: When using \autoref{alg:framework} with the selection in \autoref{rem:sec2}, we have R_T(\Lambda_T)\leq 6\triangle\sqrt{WT}, where $\triangle_t\geq \triangle$ for all $t\leq T$.

results.notes: Statement says triangle_t >= triangle, but proof says loss ranges uniformly bounded, so triangle is an upper bound on ranges.

symbols.W: complexity bound of the competing comparator sequence
symbols.Rng_top_sum: sum of the ceil(sqrt(T/(M W))) largest extended loss ranges tilde_triangle_t = max_m max(l_{t,m},l_{t-1,m}) - min_m min(l_{t,m},l_{t-1,m})

conditions: W(Lambda_T) <= W for the comparator sequence

source.label: thm:21
source.quote: When using \autoref{alg:framework} with the selection in \autoref{rem:sec1b}, we have R_T(\Lambda_T)\leq\tilde{O}\left(MW\sum_{\tau=1}^{\lceil\sqrt{\frac{T}{MW}}\rceil}\tilde{\triangle}'_\tau\right), where ... $\tilde{\triangle}'_\tau$ is the $\tau^{th}$ largest range in $\{\tilde{\triangle}_t\}_{t=1}^T$

results.notes: Paper's M is K. The proof's final bound also contains a term O~(sqrt(M W sum tilde_triangle_t^2)) that the theorem statement omits (presumably dominated). Epsilon_t uses t, so no T needed.

source.quote: When using \autoref{alg:framework} with the selection in \autoref{rem:sec1b}, we have R_T(\Lambda_T)\leq\tilde{O}\left(\tilde{\triangle}\sqrt{MWT}\right), where $\tilde{\triangle}\geq \tilde{\triangle}_t$ for all $t\leq T$.
